capabilities: Replace emoji field icons with text labels in rendered tasks and query reports
Keep Tasks date editor and right-click menu working on labeled fields
Restore original field text by toggling the setting or disabling the plugin
Define custom labels, saved display presets, and per-folder rules (Pro)
Apply a compact layout to recognized field containers (Pro)
extras: Freemium: fixed labels are free; custom labels, presets, folder rules, and compact spacing require a $5/month or $15 one-time GitHub Sponsors payment with GitHub device-flow sign-in. Updates open a 'What's new' tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README lists untested platforms and scenarios.
intentEvidence: shows English text for the dates, priority, and recurrence in tasks rendered by the Tasks community plugin
motivation: The author built it for reports with several kinds of date where you do not want to look up the meaning of each icon.
problem: Tasks emoji shorthand fields are hard to tell apart in reports with several kinds of date, forcing users to memorize what each icon means.

relations.evidence: Install Tasks and enable it first. This adapter was checked with Tasks 8.5.0.

summary: Display adapter that shows English text labels (Due, Priority, Repeat) for date, priority, and recurrence fields in tasks rendered by the Tasks plugin.
